description: Bright architectural Penthouse Condo with BEAUTIFUL VIEWS and 17+ foot ceilings situated in prime interior facing location of Encino Spa South. SMARTLY UPDATED WITH ALL NEW WINDOWS AND SLIDING DOORS. Desirable floor plan features 2 bedrooms and 2 baths on main level at opposite ends of unit. Top floor condo is a sunlit jewel, featuring a breathtaking wall of NE facing windows, and a statement sculptural spiral staircase. Loft leads to private rooftop deck with jetliner views featuring a 180 degree panorama of the Santa Monica and San Gabriel Mountains.1938 square feet of airy living space, three parking spaces (one tandem) and in-unit laundry. Easy access to 101 and 405. HOA includes water, Spectrum internet and cable (many streamers included), earthquake insurance. Encino Spa South is a complex known for its meandering pathways, and amenities including pool, spa, sauna, fitness center and clubhouse. “Lock and Go” or work from home, your sanctuary in LA.  INTERACTIVE VIRTUAL TOURS AVAILABLE ON ALL PLATFORMS. Dramatic condos like this do not come up often!
